notes:
1. Single-Word Dashboard Cards: Redesigned KPI metrics into crisp single-word titles (Sales, Cash, Receivables, Payables, Profit) with simplified terminology and high-contrast collection badges.
2. Minimal Billing Cart Action: Swapped bulky buttons for a fast, minimal text 'Add' action without cluttering icons.
3. Complete Removal of Estimate Bills: Eliminated estimate bills throughout the software; streamlined billing to standard GST Tax Invoices.
4. Named Hold Queue: Replaced generic hold timestamps with customer-attributed badges (Hold: [Customer Name]).
5. 10,000+ Items High-Density Grid & Pagination: Implemented responsive pagination controls (15/25/50/100 per page) and compact rows to prevent scroll fatigue.
6. Collapsible Vertical Category Drawer: Swapped bulky horizontal category bar for a space-saving collapsible sidebar with live item counts.
